title: Water Cycle dashboard layout
method: Frozen actual runtime in an owned ephemeral localhost server and isolated Chromium. Native controls, SVG geometry and container font scaling, reading order and measured layout gaps, scenario evidence and paused parcel preservation. No learner tabs, port 8770, runtime edits, or Git writes.
measurementNote: SVG geometry is measured after two animation frames. Text bounds are assessed in both axes and rendered font sizes include SVG scale. The frozen baseline in this report directory supplies before measurements.
